description: This is an inferno grenade, designed to channel Netherum energy to increase its incendiary power.  Once you throw it, you will have five seconds to get away before it explodes into a raging firestorm.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

description: This is an active inferno grenade.  Better throw it!
//countdown_destroy: REQUIRED.  A countdown_action fires EVERY turn once item_counter hits 0 -- the counter is not reset and revert_to is never consulted on that path (item.cpp:11259-11270).  countdown_destroy is the only in-band exit; every vanilla BN countdown_action is a `transform`, which terminates by changing the item's type instead.  Without this the grenade detonates on a loop.  Note this makes revert_to below unreachable.

description: This is a post-apocalyptic recreation of an inferno grenade, less powerful than a lab-made one but still very dangerous.  Once you throw it, you will have five seconds to get away before it explodes into a raging firestorm.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

description: This is an active makeshift inferno grenade.  Better throw it!

A strange grenade, designed like nothing you've seen before.  It's round, with flat black crystalline panels like television screens on four sides, and two buttons on either end.  On both of the buttons is a large Ψ, surrounded by a circle with a line through it.

use_action.msg: You press the buttons on the sides of the null grenade.

description: This null grenade is activate and ready to unleash its pulse.  You'd better throw it!
//revert_to: Unreachable while countdown_destroy is set -- the destroy branch returns before revert() is ever reached.  Kept because grenade_anti_psi_expended is still real loot.  A husk IS achievable if wanted: BN does have spell extra_effects (magic.cpp:316) and a spawn_item effect, so grenade_anti_psi_explosion could chain a PERMANENT spawn_item.  Not done because spawn_ethereal_item always adds to the AVATAR's inventory, never the target tile -- a thrown grenade's husk would appear in your pocket.

description: A strange grenade, designed like nothing you've seen before.  It's round, with flat black crystalline panels like television screens on four sides, and two buttons on either end.  On both of the buttons is a large Ψ, surrounded by a circle with a line through it.  The buttons on either end are depressed.

A matrix crystal attuned to pyrokinesis.  This one has a (currently) stable loop of energy set up within it.  It would take only a thought to destabilize the energy loop and set up a reaction that would lead to a massive explosion.  The blast from this is likely to kill you if you don't shelter behind something extremely resilient.  Underground would be even better.

use_action.msg: With a thought, you destabilize the matrix crystal.

description: A matrix crystal attuned to pyrokinesis.  The faint light in its depths is growing brighter and brighter, and the crystal itself is heating up as you hold it.  The blast from this is likely to kill you if you don't shelter behind something extremely resilient.  Underground would be even better.

The LV429 fires a series of extremely short high-energy laser pulses, more like bullets than a traditional laser beam, greatly reducing dwell time and increasing weapon effectiveness.  Matrix crystal technology has made the weapon compact enough to be man-portable and provided it with enough power for essentially unlimited combat operations, but heat dissipation is still a problem, preventing it from being fired more than once every few seconds.

description: The world where this crowd-control weapon came from made great use of psionic technology, but it wasn't enough to save them from their own Cataclysm.  The Exodii left most devices they found in the ruins, assuming that they would be too difficult to maintain, but took some of the simpler weapons with them.  The Onšut §A overloads the target's mind, trapping them in a hallucinatory waking dream.  This renders them almost completely harmless while in effect, with the unfortunate disadvantage of not affecting zombies.
